title: Micah Parsons won't practice this week, Packers don't rule out Week 8 return

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Micah Parsons won't practice this week, Packers don't rule out Week 8 return
sources.description: Packers defensive end Micah Parsons said last week that he's "gonna make sure everything is right" before he returns from last season's torn ACL and that won't happen this week.
